verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents both the Automation API (a programmatic SDK for driving Pulumi programs without the CLI) and a Pulumi Cloud REST API callable from the CLI, giving AI-native users a documented public interface to drive infrastructure operations; it also has a first-party MCP server for AI assistants. missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s at standard paths) and independent hands-on corroboration of API robustness.
